claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Probucol is a lipophilic antioxidant and ABCA1 inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is not expected to kill cancer cells; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting nonspecific oxidative/lysosomal stress rather than a targeted cytotoxic mechanism.
